innovation.inno_desc: Explore the cutting-edge applications of graphene in modern industries — from coatings, EV tires, and smart fabrics, to advanced pipeline solutions.

section_1.title: COATING
section_1.detail: Graphene plays a crucial role in coating applications due to its outstanding physical and chemical properties compared to conventional materials. It is used as an “Advanced Coating Material” to enhance durability, strength, and other special properties of various surfaces.

section_2.title: EV TIRES
section_2.detail:
1. EV vehicles require tires with lower wear and higher range. Graphene helps reduce rolling resistance, improving efficiency.
2. Using graphene as a filler or additive can make EV tires more sustainable compared to conventional materials.
3. Manufacturers and researchers are increasingly interested in graphene. For example, Levidian collaborates with research organizations to test graphene in tire materials.

section_3.title: FABRIC
section_3.detail: Graphene has excellent thermal and electrical conductivity. When applied to fabrics, it helps distribute heat or regulate the wearer’s temperature. Projects like Graphene Flagship coat graphene layers onto textile fibers, producing conductive, lightweight, flexible, and breathable fabrics.

section_4.title: PIPELINE
section_4.detail:
1. Industrial pipelines are exposed to high temperatures, pressure, and corrosive substances — graphene coatings improve durability and thermal conductivity.
2. Companies like CUBSON use graphene-based powder coatings for oil and gas pipelines to enhance resistance to heat and chemicals.

section_5.title: MILITARY
section_5.detail:
Armor and Protective Equipment
 1.Personal Armor(Body Armor/ Helmets) Graphene coatings or inclusions to increase strength and impact resistance Weight reduction and improved mobility
2.Vehicle Armor Graphene is incorporated into composite materials for armored vehicles to reduce weight while maintaining strength

section_6.title: CONCREAT
section_6.detail: Graphene-reinforced concrete is one of the fastest-growing construction material innovations in recent years, as graphene can “enhance” concrete properties in several areas, including strength, water resistance, crack resistance, and durability.

section_7.title: WIRE
section_7.detail: “Graphene-based cable insulation” is another promising application in the electrical and electronic materials industry. This is because graphene can significantly enhance the strength, thermal conductivity, and resistance to degradation of insulation.

overview.title: Company Overview
overview.detail: PBR Co., Ltd. was established in 2023 to serve industrial sectors with innovative solutions in automation systems,machine design, and engineering consultation. The company also engages in the import and export of spare parts and mechanical equipment.

research.title: Research & Development
research.detail:
Our research focuses on Graphene-based materials including Graphene Oxide (GO) and Reduced Graphene Oxide (rGO). This effort is led by Professor Dr. Pichatt Palanugoo, a leading expert in industrial nanotechnology. 

In collaboration with Pisut Logistics Public Co., Ltd. and TMC ThaiMechatronics Co., Ltd., PBR develops large-scale automated production systems and supports advanced industrial innovation in Thailand.
